text.tspan: Can the test find a bias we planted on purpose, and does it stay quiet when group labels are fake? The
price-validity check (Table A1) is not in these runs.
Pilot preview: built only to test the figure code, not a finding.

text.tspan: These checks run before any group result is examined. Planted-name lines are colored by name group; the label at each line's end names them,
each after a square in its group's color.
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
